title: App file (data/apps/<stem>.json)
description: One file per AppSource listing. Three zones: source (from AppSource, overwritten each refresh), mapping (machine-made, paraphrased, regenerated when the listing changes), curated (yours, never touched by scripts). No verbatim listing text is stored here.

appId.description: AppSource uniqueProductId, the real key. Example: PUBID.x|AID.y|PAPPID.<guid>

guid.description: PAPPID of a BC app. null for SaaS offers, which have no app guid.

source.description: Factual fields from the AppSource catalog. Refreshed monthly. Never edit by hand.

productType.description: Marketplace product type: a BC app (extension) or a SaaS offer tagged for Business Central.

mentionsBC.description: Title or description names Business Central (NAV never counts). A SaaS offer is shown only when this is set, and then as working with Business Central.

allCountries.description: Listing says the app works in every country where Business Central is available. Shown when no specific countries are mapped.

removedOn.description: Set when the listing disappears from the catalog.

mapping.description: Machine-made interpretation of the listing, in our own words. Regenerated only when source.sourceHash changes and curated.locked is false.

sourceHash.description: source.sourceHash this mapping was made from. Different = stale.

summary.description: One line in our own words. Null until written.

shape.description: What kind of app: a process app, a connector, a tool, an add-on to another app, an industry solution, a localization, a language pack, or a hosted platform (SaaS that runs outside BC and integrates with it).

claims.description: Paraphrased: what the app claims to do.

curated.description: Your corrections. Scripts never write here. overrides win over mapping.

overrides.description: Any mapping field name -> value that replaces it.

locked.description: True = mapping is never regenerated for this app.
